name: bridge-platform
description: Bridge AI platform monorepo — substrate, governance spine, capability runtime.

scripts.check:no-dummy-runtime: sh -c 'set -e; MATCHES=$(grep -RIn "dummy_" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=dist --exclude-dir=.turbo --exclude-dir=test --exclude-dir=fixtures --exclude-dir=seed --exclude="*.test.ts" --exclude="*.spec.ts" --exclude="dummy-prefix.js" --exclude="eslint.config.js" . || true); if [ -n "$MATCHES" ]; then echo "$MATCHES"; echo; echo "check:no-dummy-runtime: found dummy_ in runtime code (see above). Runtime product code must carry zero dummy/demo data — see CLAUDE.md real-data-only policy. Test fixtures belong in a test/ dir using the test_fixture_ prefix."; exit 1; else echo "check:no-dummy-runtime: OK — no dummy_ found outside test/fixture dirs."; fi'
